description: This file defines data structures and functions related to bitmap manipulation and compression, specifically implementing the EWAH bitmap compression scheme. It includes function prototypes, macro definitions, and inline functions for efficient bit operations such as setting bits, serialization, and iteration in compressed bitmaps.

classes.name: ewah_bitmap
classes.description: A structure representing an EWAH compressed bitmap, including a buffer of 64-bit words, size metrics, and a run-length word pointer.

classes.name: ewah_iterator
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing an uncompressed view of an EWAH bitmap in a sequential manner.

classes.name: ewah_or_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for performing logical OR over multiple EWAH bitmaps efficiently.

classes.name: bitmap
classes.description: Uncompressed bitmap structure supporting basic bit operations and conversions to/from EWAH format.

methods.name: ewah_pool_new
methods.description: Allocates a new EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_pool_free
methods.description: Frees a given EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new EWAH compressed bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_free
methods.description: Deallocates memory associated with an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_to
methods.description: Serializes the bitmap to an output using a user-defined write function.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_strbuf
methods.description: Serializes the bitmap into a string buffer.

methods.name: ewah_read_mmap
methods.description: Reads bitmap data from a memory-mapped source.

methods.name: ewah_checksum
methods.description: Computes a checksum for the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_each_bit
methods.description: Iterates over all set bits in the bitmap, invoking a callback.

methods.name: ewah_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the bitmap in uncompressed form.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to yield the next uncompressed word representing bits from the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an OR iterator over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next word from the OR operation over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources used by the OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation between two EWAH bitmaps, storing the result in an output bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds a series of empty (all 0s or 1s) words to the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
methods.description: Adds literal words to the bitmap, optionally negated.

methods.name: ewah_add
methods.description: Adds a single uncompressed word to the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_new
methods.description: Creates a new uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_word_alloc
methods.description: Allocates an uncompressed bitmap with a specified number of words.

methods.name: bitmap_dup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_unset
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit in an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two uncompressed bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_equals_ewah
methods.description: Checks equality between an uncompressed bitmap and an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if one bitmap is a subset of another.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if an EWAH bitmap is a subset of an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_to_ewah
methods.description: Converts an uncompressed bitmap to an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_to_bitmap
methods.description: Converts an EWAH bitmap to an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_and_not
methods.description: Performs AND NOT operation between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_or_ewah
methods.description: Performs OR operation with an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_or
methods.description: Performs OR operation between two uncompressed bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if an uncompressed bitmap has no bits set.

methods.name: int ewah_bit_ctz64(uint64_t x)

methods.name: uint32_t ewah_bit_popcount64(uint64_t x)
methods.description: unavailable
